[SWS_DM_02179] Operation terminate execution
⌈
If a SOVD method to terminated an operation is received and, if needed, the proxim-
ity_challenge validation according to [SWS_DM_02173] succeeded, the DM
shall call ara::diag::SovdOperationExecution::Terminate of the SovdOp-
erationExecution assigned to the execution-id [SWS_DM_02177] of the re-
quest body.
Terminating an SovdOperationExecution will discard the SovdOperationExe-
cution instance and further method calls on the execution-id are no longer pos-
sible and the result of such a call is undefined.
⌋
